description: Defines the MockDoorLock class, a simulated Zigbee device representing a door lock with capabilities for battery status and tamper detection, including methods for locking, unlocking, toggling, and managing PIN codes.

classes.name: MockDoorLock
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee door lock device with capabilities for battery and tamper detection, including lock control and PIN management.

methods.name: MockDoorLock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock door lock with optional EUI64 identifier and setting up associated clusters.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Returns whether the door lock is currently locked.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the door.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the door.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the lock state.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Checks if the battery level is low.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Sets the low battery status.

methods.name: setBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Sets the battery voltage.

methods.name: getBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Retrieves the current battery voltage.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Checks if the device has been tampered with.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tampered status.

methods.name: isInvalidCodeEntryLimit
methods.description: Checks if the invalid code entry limit is set.

methods.name: setInvalidCodeEntryLimit
methods.description: Sets the invalid code entry limit.

methods.name: setLockBoltJammed
methods.description: Indicates if the lock bolt is jammed.

methods.name: isLockBoltJammed
methods.description: Checks if the lock bolt is jammed.

methods.name: addPin
methods.description: Adds a PIN code for a user.

methods.name: getPinCount
methods.description: Returns the number of PIN codes.

methods.name: getMaxPinCodeLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum PIN code length supported.

methods.name: getMinPinCodeLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum PIN code length supported.

methods.name: getMaxPinCodesSupported
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of PIN codes supported.

methods.name: getAutoRelockSeconds
methods.description: Gets the auto-relock timeout in seconds.

methods.name: setAutoRelockSeconds
methods.description: Sets the auto-relock timeout.

methods.name: getPins
methods.description: Retrieves the list of PIN entries.
